These settings replace yours in Corbanu Terminal sessions and their child agents:
"now" shows this session; web search, environment, shell and roles are as loaded at launch.

    (secretless_agent_launch) no command runs outside the sandbox, so none is offered; permission-request tools are off
  Aggressive: write only in the current folder (where the Corbanu home and the nested-launch registry stay read-only): no extra writable folders, no /
    tmp or $TMPDIR; approved commands stay inside it too; escalation and permission-request tools are off; the project's .git, .codex and .agents stay
    read-only, even with Grant once (it only lets one command write git hooks and config kept outside a .git folder and, when the current folder holds
    your home folder, start-up files, login agents and .claude settings); reading credential files (.env, .env.* and .envrc files, also ones created

    agent commands and is never granted, not even once (switch to Permissive in /security to allow it); on Linux and Windows a command is stopped when

• Sandbox: write only in the current folder (where the Corbanu home and the nested-launch registry stay read-only): no extra writable folders, no /tmp

    your home folder, start-up files, login agents and .claude settings); reading credential files (.env, .env.* and .envrc files, also ones created

    agent commands and is never granted, not even once (switch to Permissive in /security to allow it); on Linux and Windows a command is stopped when
    such a file appears while it runs, and a process already waiting for that file can read it in the moment before the stop; a credential file that
    is a link must be replaced with a regular file or moved out of the folder
• Approvals: untrusted: you approve every command that is not known read-only (reviewer: you, never auto-review)
• Network: off for agent commands; web search off
• Vault: the vault store and sign-in file are unreadable to agent commands, and direct `corbanu vault …` commands are refused; secret-like environment
    variables (KEY, SECRET, TOKEN, VAULT, PASSWORD, PASSPHRASE, CREDENTIAL) are removed, and with secretless_agent_launch on so is every other
    variable outside an allowlist (for example PATH, HOME, locale, terminal, proxy and tool locations; set others explicitly in
    shell_environment_policy.set); login profiles and shell snapshots are not used
• Model keys: provider API keys from the environment or the vault are held by the isolated credential broker, which sends model requests for Corbanu
    (sign-in tokens are passed to it; command, AWS and header sign-ins are not brokered; realtime and websockets are off); if it cannot start, model
    requests are refused, never sent directly (broker_model_auth; `broker_model_auth = false` in your own config keeps it off)
• Child agents: spawned agents get the same values; custom roles that would change them are refused at start; Claude panes are refused because Claude
    Code runs outside the sandbox, unless contained_external_agents and secretless_agent_launch run them in it, asking you before every command, file
    edit and web request (reading files stays automatic) (Claude Code sign-in still runs)
• Nested agents: agent commands can start other agents (`corbanu exec`, `review`, `resume`, `fork`, a new session, `app-server` or `mcp-server`)
    without Aggressive enforced
• Protected paths: credential files (such as .env and keychains) are no longer denied to agent commands; your own sandbox settings decide, except that
